speaker: alice
text: Right, environment desk, and it is peak whale season out on the water. Humpbacks are cruising south past Hervey Bay and right down through the Gold Coast, and whale watching boats are absolutely chocka with people hoping for a breach.

speaker: charlie
text: Nothing beats a good breach, ay, big fella just launching himself out of the drink for no reason other than he can. Meanwhile out on the reef, monitoring crews reckon they're seeing decent signs of coral bouncing back in spots, right on cue for spring spawning.

speaker: alice
text: That spawning event is one of the wildest things in nature, the whole reef basically goes off like fireworks under the water once a year. Fingers crossed for a big one this season, our reef deserves a win.
